member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.BaseContext
member.summary: Provides a base context class for logging operations and utility functions across the VisioForge SDK. This class serves as a foundation for other SDK components, offering centralized logging capabilities and shared utilities like random number generation.

member.summary: The Serilog logger instance used for structured logging throughout the SDK.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.BaseContext.Rnd
member.summary: Gets a shared random number generator instance for use across the SDK. This provides a convenient way to generate random values for various operations such as unique identifiers, test data, or randomization features.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.BaseContext.SetLogger(Serilog.ILogger)
member.summary: Sets the Serilog logger instance to be used for all logging operations in this context. This allows for centralized logging configuration and ensures consistent log formatting across all SDK components that inherit from this base context.
member.param: The Serilog logger instance to use for logging operations. Can be null to disable logging.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.BaseContext.GetLogger

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.DeviceEnumerator
member.summary: Provides specialized enumeration for Allied Vision industrial cameras using the Vimba X SDK integration. This partial class handles discovery and management of Allied Vision machine vision cameras including GigE Vision, USB3 Vision, and Camera Link cameras. Integrates with Allied Vision's Vimba X library for native camera enumeration, device information retrieval, and GenTL provider management. Essential for professional machine vision and industrial imaging applications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides comprehensive audio device enumeration capabilities across multiple platforms and APIs. This partial class handles discovery and monitoring of audio capture sources and output devices using GStreamer's device monitoring framework. Supports cross-platform audio device detection including DirectSound, WASAPI, PulseAudio, ALSA, and Core Audio with real-time device change notifications and permission handling for mobile platforms.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides specialized enumeration for Basler industrial cameras using the Pylon SDK integration. This partial class handles discovery and management of Basler machine vision cameras including GigE Vision, USB3 Vision, and Camera Link cameras. Integrates with Basler's Pylon library for native camera enumeration, device information retrieval, and camera capability detection. Essential for professional machine vision and industrial imaging applications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides specialized enumeration for Blackmagic Design DeckLink professional video hardware. This partial class handles discovery and management of DeckLink capture and playback devices including video sources, audio sources, video sinks, and audio sinks. Manages professional broadcast hardware interfaces for high-quality video capture, playback, and signal monitoring with real-time device detection and signal loss notifications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides GenICam (Generic Interface for Cameras) device enumeration for industrial and scientific cameras. This partial class handles discovery and management of GenICam-compliant cameras including machine vision cameras, scientific imaging devices, and industrial cameras using the GenICam standard. Supports camera enumeration with detailed device information, pixel format detection, and fallback mechanisms for robust camera discovery in professional imaging applications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Cross-platform device enumerator that discovers and manages audio/video input devices, professional hardware, and network sources across all supported platforms. This class provides unified access to webcams, microphones, capture cards, IP cameras (ONVIF), NDI sources, Decklink devices, and industrial cameras (GenICam/GigE Vision). Supports both synchronous and asynchronous device discovery with platform-specific optimizations.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides Network Device Interface (NDI) source discovery and enumeration capabilities. This partial class handles detection of NDI video and audio sources over IP networks, enabling real-time video streaming and production workflows. Manages NDI device provider lifecycle, source discovery with retry logic, and maintains collections of available NDI sources for professional broadcast and streaming applications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides ONVIF (Open Network Video Interface Forum) device discovery for IP-based security cameras and video surveillance systems. This partial class handles network-based discovery of ONVIF-compliant devices including IP cameras, NVRs, and video management systems using WS-Discovery protocol. Supports timeout configuration, cancellation tokens, and asynchronous discovery operations for professional surveillance and security applications.
The namespace contains core components and utilities for VisioForge multimedia SDKs. This includes device enumeration, media processing, and various helper classes.

Provides comprehensive video capture device enumeration and monitoring across multiple platforms. This partial class handles discovery of video capture sources including webcams, capture cards, and virtual devices using GStreamer's device monitoring framework. Supports platform-specific providers like DirectShow (Windows), AVFoundation (macOS/iOS), V4L2 (Linux), and UVC devices with real-time device change notifications and permission handling.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.DLL
member.summary: Cross-platform native library loading and mapping utilities for the VisioForge SDK. Provides automatic resolution of platform-specific native library names and handles dynamic loading of required native dependencies across Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms. This class ensures proper native library loading for ONVIF and other platform-specific components.
member.remarks: The DLL class handles: - Cross-platform native library name mapping (Windows DLL, Linux SO, macOS dylib) - Automatic architecture detection (x86, x64) for proper library selection - Runtime library resolution via NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver - Support for ONVIF camera integration libraries across all platforms - Fallback mechanisms for library loading failures This functionality is essential for proper operation of platform-specific features like ONVIF camera support.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.DSP.DSPConst.DefaultSampleSize
member.summary: Used by DSP Filters to Set the default Split Size. This is needed when a large Buffer arrives and the Application would't respond until the DSP is done. If the SampleSize of an Filter is Set to Value > 0 then the Buffer will be splitted at this amount of Samples and processed until all Samples are processed. After every Process, Application.ProcessMessages is called to make the Application respond to Windows. DefaultSampleSize is just a default Value. The SampleSize can be changed on every Filter seperate.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.DSP.DSPConverter
member.summary: Static methods to convert between different sample formats.

remarks.para: Code is mainly based on information available on the original C source code pa_converters.c from Portable Audio I/O Library.
This class try to be as fast as possible without using unsafe code.
Dither isn't currently supported. Currently supported conversions are 'to' and 'from' conversions between the following value types:
Integer 8-bit (byte), Integer 16-bit (Int16), Integer 32-bit (Int32), Single precision 32-bit floating point (float).
Which are the most common PCM formats.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.DSP.Equalizer.AudioEncoding.MPEG_ADTS_AAC
member.summary: Advanced Audio Coding (AAC) audio in Audio Data Transport Stream (ADTS) format. The format block is a WAVEFORMATEX structure with wFormatTag equal to WAVE_FORMAT_MPEG_ADTS_AAC.
member.remarks: The WAVEFORMATEX structure specifies the core AAC-LC sample rate and number of channels, prior to applying spectral band replication (SBR) or parametric stereo (PS) tools, if present. No additional data is required after the WAVEFORMATEX structure.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.FFT
member.summary: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) implementation for audio frequency analysis and spectrum computation. Provides high-performance FFT calculations for real-time audio processing, frequency analysis, and spectrum visualization within the VisioForge SDK. Based on the Cooley-Tukey FFT algorithm with optimizations for power-of-two sample sizes commonly used in audio processing.
member.remarks: FFT capabilities include: - Forward and inverse FFT computation for complex number arrays - Power spectrum calculation for frequency domain analysis - Peak frequency detection for audio analysis applications - Optimized bit-reversal and butterfly operations for performance - Support for real and imaginary input data processing - Amplitude normalization for proper spectrum scaling This implementation is based on the 1998 version by Don Cross with enhancements for .NET integration. Licensed under a permissive license allowing commercial use and redistribution.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.AlliedVision.VimbaAPI.VmbFeaturesList(System.IntPtr,System.IntPtr,System.UInt32,System.UInt32@,System.UInt32)
member.summary: Lists all the features for this entity.
member.remarks: This function lists all implemented features, whether they are currently available or not. The list of features does not change as long as the entity is connected. This function is usually called twice: once with an empty list to query the length of the list, and then again with a list of the correct length. If VmbErrorMoreData is returned and numFound is non-null, the total number of features has been written to numFound. If there are more elements in featureInfoList than features available, the remaining elements are filled with zero-initialized VmbFeatureInfo_t structs.
member.param: Handle for an entity that exposes features.
An array of VmbFeatureInfo_t to be filled by the API. May be null if numFound is used for size query.
Number of VmbFeatureInfo_t elements found. May be null if featureInfoList is not null.
member.returns: An error code indicating success or the type of error that occurred.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlDevice.ShowIntegrationGuidance
member.summary:
Integration guidance for GenTL devices:
1. Device Creation: - Requires a valid GenTL system handle from ArvGentlSystem - Interface ID and Device ID must be obtained from GenTL discovery
2. Device Operations: - GenTL devices inherit from ArvDevice base functionality - All standard device operations available through ArvDevice.cs - Camera-level operations available through ArvCamera.cs
3. Stream Creation: - Use ArvGentlStream for GenTL stream operations - Streams created through device's create_stream method
4. Error Handling: - Check for IntPtr.Zero return values - Use error parameter for detailed error information - GenTL errors follow standard GError pattern

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlInterface.ShowIntegrationGuidance
member.summary:
Integration guidance for GenTL interfaces:
1. Interface Access: - Use GetInstance() to get the singleton GenTL interface - GenTL interface is automatically discovered by Aravis system - Available when GenTL producers are installed on the system
2. Device Discovery: - Use ArvInterface base methods for device enumeration - GenTL devices will be discovered through interface operations - Device IDs can be used with ArvGentlDevice.CreateDevice()
3. Interface Operations: - All standard interface operations available through ArvInterface.cs - GenTL-specific functionality integrated with base interface - Update device list and open device methods work with GenTL
4. System Integration: - GenTL interface works with ArvSystem enumeration - Appears in system interface list when available - Compatible with standard Aravis discovery patterns
5. Error Handling: - Check for IntPtr.Zero return values - GenTL errors follow standard GError pattern - Interface availability depends on GenTL producer installation

T:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlStream
member.summary: C# wrapper for Aravis GenTL Stream functionality. Provides GenTL stream operations for GenTL-compatible camera streaming.
member.remarks:
GenTL (Generic Transport Layer) streams provide standardized streaming operations for GenTL-compatible cameras. This wrapper enables .NET applications to manage GenTL camera data streams with type safety.
GenTL streams extend the base ArvStream functionality with GenTL-specific features: - GenTL producer integration - Transport layer specific optimizations - GenTL buffer management - Producer-specific streaming capabilities

member.remarks: This is a helper method for GenTL stream type identification. Actual implementation would use GObject type system for proper type checking.

member.summary: Gets the GenTL stream type name
member.returns: The type name for GenTL streams

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlStream.ShowIntegrationGuidance
member.summary:
Integration guidance for GenTL streams:
1. Stream Creation: - GenTL streams are created through GenTL device instances - Use ArvDevice.arv_device_create_stream() on GenTL devices - Stream creation handled by GenTL producer automatically
2. Stream Operations: - All standard stream operations available through ArvStream.cs - Buffer management through ArvBuffer.cs - Acquisition control through ArvStream start/stop methods
3. GenTL Features: - GenTL-specific optimizations handled transparently - Producer-specific buffer management automatic - Transport layer optimizations integrated
4. Buffer Handling: - Standard buffer operations through ArvBuffer.cs - GenTL buffer allocation handled by producer - Memory management follows standard patterns
5. Error Handling: - GenTL streams follow standard GError pattern - Stream-specific errors reported through standard mechanisms - Producer errors integrated with Aravis error handling
6. Performance: - GenTL producers may provide optimized streaming - Zero-copy operations where supported by producer - Hardware-specific optimizations automatic

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlStream.ShowUsageExamples
M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlStream.ShowProducerIntegration
member.summary:
GenTL Producer integration notes:
1. Producer Discovery: - GenTL producers automatically discovered by Aravis - Multiple producers can coexist on the system - Producer selection handled by GenTL system
2. Stream Capabilities: - Producer-specific streaming features automatically available - Hardware acceleration where supported - Transport-specific optimizations integrated
3. Buffer Management: - Producer-optimized buffer allocation - Zero-copy operations where possible - Memory mapping for performance
4. Configuration: - Producer-specific parameters accessible through GenICam - Transport layer configuration through device interface - Streaming parameters through standard Aravis API
5. Compatibility: - Standard Aravis API maintained for compatibility - GenTL features accessible through existing interfaces - Transparent integration with Aravis ecosystem

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlSystem
member.summary: C# wrapper for Aravis GenTL System functionality. Provides GenTL system management for GenTL-compatible transport layers.
member.remarks:
GenTL (Generic Transport Layer) systems provide a standardized framework for managing industrial camera transport protocols. This wrapper enables .NET applications to initialize and manage GenTL systems.
The GenTL system is the entry point for GenTL-based camera operations: 1. Initialize GenTL system 2. Discover interfaces 3. Enumerate devices 4. Create device instances

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlSystem.GetTypeName
member.summary: Gets the GenTL system type name
member.returns: The type name for GenTL systems

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvGentlSystem.ShowIntegrationGuidance
member.summary:
Integration guidance for GenTL systems:
1. System Initialization: - GenTL systems are typically initialized through ArvSystem.cs - Use ArvSystem interface enumeration to discover GenTL interfaces - GenTL system instances are managed internally by Aravis
2. Interface Discovery: - Use ArvSystem.arv_system_get_interfaces() to enumerate interfaces - GenTL interfaces will be included in the interface list - Use ArvGentlInterface for GenTL-specific interface operations
3. Device Creation: - Use ArvGentlDevice.arv_gentl_device_new() to create devices - Requires GenTL system handle, interface ID, and device ID - Device IDs obtained through interface enumeration
4. Stream Operations: - Use ArvGentlStream for GenTL-specific streaming - Streams created through GenTL device instances - Standard streaming operations through ArvStream.cs
5. Error Handling: - GenTL systems follow standard GError error handling - Check return values and error parameters - Use GError marshaling for detailed error information
6. Memory Management: - GenTL systems are managed by Aravis internally - No explicit cleanup required for system handles - Device and stream handles require proper cleanup

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvUvStream
member.summary: C# wrapper for Aravis USB Vision Stream functionality. This class provides type definitions for USB Vision stream operations. The USB Vision stream extends the base ArvStream functionality with USB-specific features.
member.remarks:
USB Vision streams are created through the base stream functionality in ArvStream.cs. This wrapper provides type-safe access to USB Vision-specific stream features while maintaining compatibility with the base stream interface.
Usage: - Use ArvStream.cs for general stream operations - Use ArvUvDevice.cs for USB Vision device-specific functionality - This wrapper provides USB Vision stream type identification

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.ArvUvStream.ShowIntegrationGuidance
member.summary:
Integration guidance for USB Vision streams:
1. Stream Creation: - Use ArvCamera.arv_camera_create_stream() for USB Vision cameras - Use ArvDevice stream creation methods from ArvUvDevice
2. Stream Operations: - All standard stream operations available through ArvStream.cs - USB-specific configuration through ArvUvDevice.cs
3. Buffer Management: - Standard buffer operations through ArvBuffer.cs - USB Vision payload handling automatic
4. USB Vision Features: - Configure USB mode through ArvUvDevice.arv_uv_device_set_usb_mode() - Set transfer size through ArvUvDevice.arv_uv_device_set_maximum_transfer_size() - USB bandwidth control through ArvCamera USB Vision API

member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum sensor size in pixels (full resolution).

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.WidthBounds
member.summary: Gets or sets the valid range and increment for image width settings.
member.remarks:
Defines the constraints for ROI width:
Min: Minimum allowed width in pixels
Max: Maximum allowed width in pixels (typically sensor width)
Increment: Width must be a multiple of this value (often 1, 2, 4, or 8)
Use these bounds when calling .

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.HeightBounds
member.summary: Gets or sets the valid range and increment for image height settings.
member.remarks:
Defines the constraints for ROI height:
Min: Minimum allowed height in pixels
Max: Maximum allowed height in pixels (typically sensor height)
Increment: Height must be a multiple of this value (often 1 or 2)
Use these bounds when calling .

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.XOffsetBounds
member.summary: Gets or sets the valid range and increment for X offset (horizontal position) of the ROI.
member.remarks:
Defines the constraints for ROI X position:
Min: Minimum X offset (usually 0)
Max: Maximum X offset (sensor width - ROI width)
Increment: X offset must be a multiple of this value
Use these bounds when calling .

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.YOffsetBounds
member.summary: Gets or sets the valid range and increment for Y offset (vertical position) of the ROI.
member.remarks:
Defines the constraints for ROI Y position:
Min: Minimum Y offset (usually 0)
Max: Maximum Y offset (sensor height - ROI height)
Increment: Y offset must be a multiple of this value
Use these bounds when calling .

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.BinningAvailable
member.summary: Gets or sets whether pixel binning is supported by the camera.
member.remarks:
Binning combines adjacent pixels to:
Increase sensitivity (brightness) by combining pixel values
Reduce resolution for higher frame rates
Reduce noise in low-light conditions
If true, use to configure binning factors.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.XBinningBounds

member.name: E:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.FrameReceived
member.summary: Event fired when a new frame is received during streaming operations.

remarks.para: This event is raised from a background timer thread, so UI updates should be marshaled to the appropriate thread.
Frame processing should be kept minimal to avoid blocking the acquisition pipeline.
The frame data is copied, so it's safe to access after the event handler returns.

member.name: E:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.FrameError
member.summary: Event fired when a frame acquisition error occurs during streaming.

remarks.para: Common causes include:

item.description: Buffer underrun (camera producing frames faster than they can be processed)
Network packet loss (GigE cameras)
USB bandwidth limitations (USB3 cameras)
Insufficient system resources

remarks.para: The streaming will typically continue after an error, but consider reducing frame rate or increasing buffer count.

member.name: E:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.StreamingStarted
member.summary: Event fired when streaming starts successfully.
member.remarks: This event indicates that the camera acquisition has started and buffers are available for frame capture.

member.name: E:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.StreamingStopped
member.summary: Event fired when streaming stops.
member.remarks: This event is fired both for normal stop operations and when streaming stops due to errors.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.#ctor(System.String,VisioForge.Core.BaseContext)
member.summary: Creates a new GenICam camera instance from a device ID.
member.param: Device ID (can be null for first available camera). Common formats include IP addresses for GigE cameras or device names.
BaseContext for logging and error reporting (optional). If null, a default context will be created.

remarks.para: This constructor creates an unconnected camera instance. Call to establish connection to the camera hardware.
The device ID format depends on the camera type:

item.description: GigE Vision: IP address (e.g., "192.168.1.100") or MAC address
USB3 Vision: Device name or serial number
Camera Link: Device identifier

remarks.para: If deviceId is null, the first available camera will be used when connecting.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.GetStreamDiagnostics
member.summary: Gets comprehensive diagnostic information about the current streaming state and performance.
member.returns: Diagnostic information including buffer counts, statistics, and error states.
member.exception: Thrown if the camera instance has been disposed.

remarks.para: This method provides detailed information about the streaming subsystem:

item.description: Buffer Information: Input, output, and filling buffer counts
Statistics: Completed frames, failed frames, and underrun counts
State Information: Whether streaming is active and stream handle validity
Error Information: Any error messages from the streaming subsystem
High Failed Buffers: Indicates camera producing frames faster than processing - reduce frame rate or increase buffer count
High Underruns: Suggests insufficient buffers or slow processing - increase buffer count or optimize frame handling
Zero Completed Buffers: Camera may not be producing frames - check exposure settings and triggers
No Input Buffers: Stream buffer creation failed - check memory availability

remarks.para: Performance Note: This method queries the stream in real-time, so it reflects current state.

remarks.para: This method performs a complete reinitialization:

item.description: Stops any active streaming operations
Cleans up existing camera and stream resources
Resets the disposed state to allow normal operation
Recreates the camera connection using original parameters
Camera was disconnected due to network issues (GigE cameras)
USB camera was unplugged and reconnected
Camera was manually disconnected using
Camera object was disposed but you want to reuse it
Recovery from communication errors

remarks.para: Important: After successful reinitialization, you should call to refresh camera capabilities, as they may have changed.
Alternative: For temporary disconnections without disposal, consider using followed by instead.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.StartStreaming
member.summary: Starts streaming frames in continuous mode with automatic buffer management.
member.returns: True if streaming started successfully, false otherwise.
member.exception: Thrown if the camera instance has been disposed.
Thrown if streaming cannot be started due to camera or configuration issues.

remarks.para: This method performs the following operations:

item.description: Ensures camera is connected (connects if necessary)
Creates stream and buffers if they don't exist
Sets acquisition mode to continuous
Starts camera acquisition
Begins frame polling timer
Fires event on success

remarks.para: Event Handling: Subscribe to before calling this method to receive frame data. Frames are delivered asynchronously via events.
Buffer Management: Buffers are created and managed automatically. The default buffer count is 10, which should be sufficient for most applications.
Thread Safety: This method is not thread-safe with respect to other camera operations.

member.summary: Stops streaming frames
member.returns: True if streaming stopped successfully

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCamera.CaptureFrame(System.Int32)
member.summary: Captures a single frame in one-shot mode with specified timeout.
member.param: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for frame capture (default: 5000). Use larger values for slow cameras or longer exposures.
member.returns: Frame data containing image information and pixel data, or null if capture failed or timed out.
member.exception: Thrown if the camera instance has been disposed.

remarks.para: This method performs a synchronous single frame capture:

item.description: Ensures camera is connected (connects if necessary)
Creates stream and buffers if they don't exist
Sets acquisition mode to single frame
Starts acquisition and waits for frame
Extracts frame data and stops acquisition

remarks.para: Timeout Considerations: The timeout should be longer than the exposure time plus any camera processing delays. For very long exposures (>1 second), increase the timeout accordingly.
Performance: This method is suitable for infrequent captures. For continuous imaging, use instead for better performance.
Thread Safety: This method blocks the calling thread until the frame is captured or timeout occurs.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.UpdateDeviceList
member.summary: Updates the device list by scanning for available GenICam-compatible cameras. Automatically cleans up cameras that are no longer available in the system.

remarks.para: This method performs the following operations:

item.description: Calls the underlying Aravis system to refresh the device list
Compares current devices with cached camera instances
Removes cameras that are no longer available (if not connected)
Adds new cameras to the internal dictionary

remarks.para: Thread Safety: This method is thread-safe and can be called from multiple threads.
Performance: This method may take some time to complete as it performs hardware enumeration. Consider calling it on a background thread in UI applications.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.PopulateCameraDictionary
member.summary: Populates the camera dictionary with discovered cameras without connecting to them.
member.remarks: This is an internal method that creates GenICamCamera instances for each discovered device and adds them to the internal cache. The cameras are not connected at this stage.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetDeviceCount
member.summary: Gets the number of currently available GenICam-compatible devices.
member.returns: The number of available cameras detected by the system.
member.remarks: This method returns the count from the most recent device enumeration. Call to refresh the device list before calling this method if you need the most up-to-date count.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetDeviceIds
member.summary: Gets device IDs for all currently available GenICam-compatible cameras.
member.returns: An array of device ID strings. Each string uniquely identifies a camera device.

remarks.para: This method automatically calls to ensure the most current device list.
Device IDs are typically in the format "Vendor_Model_SerialNumber" but the exact format depends on the camera manufacturer.
The returned array will contain "Unknown" for devices where the ID cannot be determined.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetDeviceId(System.UInt32)
member.summary: Gets the device ID for a specific camera by its enumeration index.
member.param: The zero-based index of the device in the enumeration list.
member.returns: The device ID string for the specified camera, or "Unknown" if the ID cannot be determined.
member.exception: Thrown when the specified index is greater than or equal to the number of available devices.

remarks.para: This method automatically calls to ensure the most current device list.
Device indices are assigned in the order devices are discovered and may change between enumerations.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetCamera(System.String)
member.summary: Gets a camera instance by device ID, creating it if necessary but not connecting to it.
member.param: The unique device ID of the camera to retrieve.
member.returns: A instance for the specified device, or null if the device ID is invalid or the camera cannot be created.

remarks.para: This method returns a camera instance from the internal cache. If the camera doesn't exist in the cache, it will attempt to create a new instance. The camera is not automatically connected.
Important: You must call before using this method to ensure the device is available in the enumerated list.
Use to connect to the camera before performing operations.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetCameraInternal(System.String)
member.summary: Internal method to get or create camera instances with proper recreation logic. Handles camera reinitialization when needed.
member.param: The unique device ID of the camera to retrieve.
member.returns: A instance or null if the camera cannot be created or retrieved.
member.exception: Thrown when the device ID is not found in the enumerated devices list.
member.remarks: This method handles the complex logic of camera lifecycle management including: - Checking if the camera exists in the enumerated device list - Attempting to reinitialize disposed cameras - Creating new camera instances when needed - Proper error handling and logging

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetCamera(System.UInt32)
member.summary: Gets a camera instance by its enumeration index.
member.param: The zero-based index of the camera in the device enumeration.
member.returns: A instance for the camera at the specified index.
member.exception: Thrown when the specified index is greater than or equal to the number of available devices.
Thrown when the camera cannot be retrieved or created for the specified index.

remarks.para: This method is a convenience wrapper that gets the device ID for the specified index and then retrieves the corresponding camera instance.
Note: Device indices may change between enumerations. For consistent access, consider using device IDs instead of indices.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetCameras
member.summary: Gets all available cameras as instances from the centralized cache.
member.returns: A list of instances for all available cameras. Cameras that cannot be retrieved are excluded from the list.

remarks.para: This method retrieves camera instances for all devices found in the most recent enumeration. Cameras that cannot be created or retrieved are skipped with a warning logged.
The returned cameras are not automatically connected. Use to connect to individual cameras before use.
Performance: This method may take some time if there are many cameras or if some cameras are slow to respond during instantiation.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetFirstAvailableCamera
member.summary: Gets the first available camera from the centralized cache.
member.returns: A instance for the first available camera.
member.exception: Thrown when no cameras are available or the first camera cannot be retrieved.

remarks.para: This is a convenience method for applications that only need to work with a single camera or want to use the first available camera by default.
This method automatically calls to ensure current device information.
The returned camera is not automatically connected. Use to connect to the camera before use.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.OpenCamera(System.String)
member.summary: Opens a camera for use by establishing a connection to the hardware.
member.param: The unique device ID of the camera to open.
member.returns: true if the camera was successfully opened and is ready for use; false if the camera could not be opened.

remarks.para: This method performs the following operations:

item.description: Validates the device ID and retrieves the camera instance
Checks if the camera is already connected (returns true if so)
Establishes a hardware connection to the camera
Reads camera information to populate detailed properties

remarks.para: Thread Safety: This method is thread-safe and uses internal locking.
Resource Management: Always call when done with the camera to properly release resources.
Error Handling: Detailed error information is logged. Check logs for specific failure reasons.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.CloseCamera(System.String)
member.summary: Closes a camera and disconnects it from the hardware without removing it from the cache.
member.param: The unique device ID of the camera to close.
member.returns: true if the camera was successfully closed or was already closed; false if an error occurred during the closing process.

remarks.para: This method performs the following operations:

item.description: Stops any active streaming on the camera
Disconnects the camera from the hardware
Keeps the camera instance in cache for potential reuse

remarks.para: Thread Safety: This method is thread-safe and uses internal locking.
Resource Management: This method properly releases hardware resources while maintaining the camera instance for future use.
Idempotent: It's safe to call this method multiple times on the same camera.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.IsCameraOpen(System.String)
member.summary: Checks if a camera is currently open and connected to the hardware.
member.param: The unique device ID of the camera to check.
member.returns: true if the camera is currently open and connected; false if the camera is closed, not found, or the device ID is invalid.

remarks.para: This method provides a quick way to check camera connection status without attempting to open or modify the camera state.
Thread Safety: This method is thread-safe and can be called from any thread.
Performance: This is a lightweight operation that only checks internal state.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.ForceCleanup
member.summary: Forces removal and disposal of all cameras from the cache, regardless of their current state.

remarks.para: ⚠️ WARNING: This method should be used with extreme caution as it will dispose all camera instances even if they are currently in use. This can cause exceptions in other parts of the application that are actively using cameras.
This method is intended for use in the following scenarios:

item.description: Application shutdown
Recovery from unrecoverable camera states
Memory cleanup in testing scenarios

remarks.para: Thread Safety: This method is thread-safe but will affect all threads using cameras.
Recovery: After calling this method, you must call to repopulate the camera cache before using cameras again.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.FindCamerasByVendor(System.String)
member.summary: Finds cameras by vendor name using case-insensitive partial matching.
member.param: The vendor name or partial vendor name to search for.
member.returns: A list of instances from vendors matching the specified name. Returns an empty list if no matches are found.

remarks.para: This method performs a case-insensitive search for cameras whose vendor name contains the specified string. Partial matches are supported.
Performance: This method may take some time as it needs to query device information for each available camera.
Cameras that cannot be queried are skipped with a warning logged.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.FindCamerasByModel(System.String)
member.summary: Finds cameras by model name using case-insensitive partial matching.
member.param: The model name or partial model name to search for.
member.returns: A list of instances with models matching the specified name. Returns an empty list if no matches are found.

remarks.para: This method performs a case-insensitive search for cameras whose model name contains the specified string. Partial matches are supported.
Performance: This method may take some time as it needs to query device information for each available camera.
Cameras that cannot be queried are skipped with a warning logged.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.FindCameraBySerialNumber(System.String)
member.summary: Finds a camera by its exact serial number using case-insensitive matching.
member.param: The serial number to search for.
member.returns: A instance with the matching serial number, or null if no camera with that serial number is found.

remarks.para: This method performs a case-insensitive exact match search for cameras with the specified serial number.
Performance: This method may take some time as it needs to query device information for each available camera until a match is found.
Cameras that cannot be queried are skipped with a warning logged.
Uniqueness: Serial numbers should be unique, so this method returns the first match found.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.GenICam.GenICamCameraManager.GetCamerasWithInfo
member.summary: Gets all cameras with their detailed information loaded by temporarily opening each camera.
member.returns: A list of instances with their properties populated with detailed camera information.

remarks.para: This method temporarily opens each camera to read its detailed information, then closes it immediately. This provides comprehensive camera information but has the following implications:

item.description: Performance: This operation can be slow as it connects to each camera
Exclusive Access: Cameras in use by other applications will be skipped
Resource Usage: Temporarily uses camera resources for each device
Camera discovery and enumeration interfaces
Detailed camera capability reporting
Camera selection based on specifications

remarks.para: Cameras that cannot be opened or provide information are excluded from the results.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.GStreamer.DSP.DSPConverter
member.summary: Static methods to convert between different sample formats.

remarks.para: Code is mainly based on information available on the original C source code pa_converters.c from Portable Audio I/O Library.
This class try to be as fast as possible without using unsafe code.
Dither isn't currently supported. Currently supported conversions are 'to' and 'from' conversions between the following value types:
Integer 8-bit (byte), Integer 16-bit (Int16), Integer 32-bit (Int32), Single precision 32-bit floating point (float).
Which are the most common PCM formats.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper
member.summary: Provides utility methods for array manipulation operations including concatenation, copying between different array types, and comparison.
member.remarks: This internal helper class offers optimized array operations that are used throughout the VisioForge.Core library. It includes platform-specific optimizations for Windows using native memory comparison functions.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper.ConcatArrays``1(``0[][])
member.summary: Concatenates multiple arrays of the same type into a single array.
member.typeparam: The type of elements in the arrays.
member.param: A variable number of arrays to concatenate.
member.returns: A new array containing all elements from the input arrays in the order they were provided.
member.remarks: This method efficiently concatenates multiple arrays by pre-calculating the total size and copying each array only once.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper.Concat``1(``0[],``0[])
member.summary: Concatenates two arrays of the same type into a single array.
member.typeparam: The type of elements in the arrays.
member.param: The first array to concatenate. This array will be resized to contain both arrays.
member.returns: The resized first array containing all elements from both input arrays.
member.exception: Thrown when either or is null.
member.remarks: This extension method modifies the first array by resizing it to accommodate both arrays' contents.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper.Copy(System.Byte[],System.Int16[])
member.summary: Copies data from a byte array to a short array using unmanaged memory operations.
member.param: The source byte array to copy from.
The destination short array to copy to. Must be properly sized to receive the data.
member.remarks: This method uses unmanaged memory as an intermediate buffer to perform the type conversion. The destination array must be properly sized: dst.Length should equal src.Length / 2.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper.Copy(System.Int16[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Copies data from a short array to a byte array using unmanaged memory operations.
member.param: The source short array to copy from.
The destination byte array to copy to. Must be properly sized to receive the data.
member.remarks: This method uses unmanaged memory as an intermediate buffer to perform the type conversion. The destination array must be properly sized: dst.Length should equal src.Length * 2.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ArrayHelper.CompareSlow(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Int32)
member.summary: Compares two byte arrays for equality using a managed byte-by-byte comparison.
member.param: The first byte array to compare.
The second byte array to compare.
The number of bytes to compare from the beginning of each array.
member.returns: true if the specified number of bytes are equal in both arrays; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method provides a cross-platform compatible array comparison but is slower than the native Compare method. Use this method on non-Windows platforms or when native interop is not available. The comparison stops at the first non-matching byte for efficiency.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ByteArrayComparer
member.summary: Provides functionality to compare byte arrays for equality and generate hash codes for byte arrays. This class implements for byte arrays, allowing byte arrays to be used as keys in hash-based collections such as Dictionary and HashSet.
member.remarks: This comparer performs element-by-element comparison of byte arrays and generates hash codes based on the sum of all bytes in the array. Note that the hash code algorithm is simple and may not provide optimal distribution for all use cases.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ByteArrayComparer.Equals(System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Determines whether two byte arrays are equal by comparing their elements.
member.param: The first byte array to compare. Can be null.
The second byte array to compare. Can be null.
member.returns: true if both arrays are null, or if both arrays have the same length and contain the same sequence of bytes; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method handles null arrays gracefully. Two null arrays are considered equal. If only one array is null, they are considered not equal.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.ByteArrayComparer.GetHashCode(System.Byte[])
member.summary: Generates a hash code for the specified byte array.
member.param: The byte array for which to generate a hash code. Must not be null.
member.returns: A hash code calculated as the sum of all bytes in the array. This provides a simple hash that is sufficient for many use cases.
member.exception: Thrown when is null.
member.remarks: The hash code is calculated by summing all byte values in the array. While simple, this approach may result in hash collisions for arrays with the same sum but different byte arrangements. For performance-critical applications with large datasets, consider using a more sophisticated hash algorithm.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CairoHelper
member.summary: Provides extension methods and utilities for converting SkiaSharp types to Cairo graphics library types.
member.remarks: This helper class is used internally to bridge the gap between SkiaSharp (used for cross-platform graphics) and Cairo (used by GStreamer for text and graphics rendering). All methods are extension methods that provide seamless conversion capabilities.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CairoHelper.ToCairoColor(SkiaSharp.SKColor)
member.summary: Converts a SkiaSharp color to a Cairo color.
member.param: The SkiaSharp color to convert. This color contains RGBA values in the range 0-255.
member.returns: A Cairo.Color instance with normalized RGBA values in the range 0.0-1.0.
member.remarks: This method normalizes the 8-bit color channel values (0-255) from SkiaSharp to the floating-point values (0.0-1.0) expected by Cairo.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CairoHelper.ToCairo(VisioForge.Core.Types.X.VideoEffects.FontWeight)
member.summary: Converts a VisioForge font weight enumeration to a Cairo font weight.
member.param: The VisioForge font weight to convert.
member.returns: Cairo.FontWeight.Bold if the weight value is 600 or greater (semi-bold and above); otherwise, Cairo.FontWeight.Normal.
member.remarks: Cairo has limited font weight options compared to modern font specifications. This method maps all weights of 600 and above to Bold, and everything else to Normal. The threshold of 600 corresponds to the standard semi-bold weight in typography.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CairoHelper.ToCairo(VisioForge.Core.Types.X.VideoEffects.FontStyle)
member.summary: Converts a VisioForge font style enumeration to a Cairo font slant.
member.param: The VisioForge font style to convert.
member.returns: The corresponding Cairo.FontSlant value: - Normal returns Cairo.FontSlant.Normal - Oblique returns Cairo.FontSlant.Oblique - Italic returns Cairo.FontSlant.Italic - Any other value defaults to Cairo.FontSlant.Normal
member.remarks: This method provides a direct mapping between VisioForge font styles and Cairo font slants, which are used to control the slanting or italicization of text in Cairo graphics contexts.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1
member.summary: A generic circular buffer implementation that allows efficient insertion and removal of elements at both ends of the buffer. When the buffer reaches full capacity, adding new elements will automatically remove elements from the opposite end.

remarks.para: When writing to a full buffer:

item.description: PushBack() removes the element at Front() (this[0])
PushFront() removes the element at Back() (this[Size-1])

remarks.para: This implementation is inspired by the Boost circular_buffer library: http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_53_0/libs/circular_buffer/doc/circular_buffer.html

member.typeparam: The type of elements stored in the circular buffer.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1._buffer
member.summary: The internal array that stores the buffer elements.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1._start
member.summary: The index of the first element in the circular buffer.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1._end
member.summary: The index position after the last element in the circular buffer.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1._size
member.summary: The current number of elements stored in the buffer.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.#ctor(System.Int32)
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with the specified capacity.
member.param: The maximum number of elements that the buffer can hold. Must be positive.
member.exception: Thrown when capacity is less than 1.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.#ctor(System.Int32,`0[])
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with the specified capacity and pre-fills it with the provided items.
member.param: The maximum number of elements that the buffer can hold. Must be positive.
Initial items to fill the buffer with. The length must not exceed the capacity. Tip: Use Skip(x).Take(y).ToArray() to build this parameter from any enumerable.
member.exception: Thrown when capacity is less than 1 or when items length exceeds capacity.
Thrown when items is null.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Capacity
member.summary: Gets the maximum capacity of the circular buffer.
member.remarks: When the buffer reaches maximum capacity (IsFull = true), pushing new elements will automatically remove elements from the opposite end to maintain the capacity limit.
member.value: The maximum number of elements that can be stored in the buffer.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.IsFull
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the circular buffer is at full capacity.
member.remarks: When the buffer is full, adding new elements will cause elements to be removed from the opposite end of the buffer to maintain the capacity constraint.
member.value: true if the buffer contains the maximum number of elements; otherwise, false.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.IsEmpty
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the circular buffer is empty.
member.value: true if the buffer contains no elements; otherwise, false.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Size
member.summary: Gets the current number of elements contained in the circular buffer.
member.value: The number of elements currently stored in the buffer.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Front
member.summary: Returns the element at the front of the buffer without removing it.
member.returns: The element at the front of the buffer (equivalent to this[0]).
member.exception: Thrown when the buffer is empty.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Back
member.summary: Returns the element at the back of the buffer without removing it.
member.returns: The element at the back of the buffer (equivalent to this[Size - 1]).
member.exception: Thrown when the buffer is empty.

member.name: P:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Item(System.Int32)
member.summary: Gets or sets the element at the specified index in the buffer.
member.param: The zero-based index of the element to get or set.
member.returns: The element at the specified index.
member.remarks: The index does not wrap around; valid indices are in the range [0, Size).
member.exception: Thrown when index is negative, greater than or equal to Size, or when the buffer is empty.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.PushBack(`0)
member.summary: Adds an element to the back of the circular buffer.
member.param: The element to add to the back of the buffer.
member.remarks: After this operation, Back() and this[Size-1] will return the newly added element. If the buffer is full, the element at the front (Front()/this[0]) will be removed to make room for the new element.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.PushFront(`0)
member.summary: Adds an element to the front of the circular buffer.
member.param: The element to add to the front of the buffer.
member.remarks: After this operation, Front() and this[0] will return the newly added element. If the buffer is full, the element at the back (Back()/this[Size-1]) will be removed to make room for the new element.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.PopBack
member.summary: Removes and discards the element at the back of the circular buffer.
member.remarks: This operation decreases the buffer size by 1.
member.exception: Thrown when the buffer is empty.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.PopFront
member.summary: Removes and discards the element at the front of the circular buffer.
member.remarks: This operation decreases the buffer size by 1.
member.exception: Thrown when the buffer is empty.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.Clear
member.summary: Removes all elements from the circular buffer.
member.remarks: After this operation, Size will be 0 but Capacity remains unchanged. All elements in the internal buffer are set to their default values.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.ToArray
member.summary: Copies all elements from the circular buffer to a new array.
member.returns: A new array containing copies of the elements in the buffer, ordered from front to back.
member.remarks: The returned array preserves the logical order of elements (from front to back), regardless of their physical arrangement in the internal buffer.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.ToArraySegments
member.summary: Gets the contents of the buffer as two ArraySegment instances without copying the elements.
member.returns: An IList containing two ArraySegment instances that represent the buffer contents.

remarks.para: This method provides a zero-copy view of the buffer contents, which is useful for performance-critical scenarios such as network operations (e.g., Send(IList<ArraySegment<byte>>)).
The segments preserve the logical order of elements from front to back. Either or both segments may be empty depending on the buffer state.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.GetEnumerator
member.summary: Returns an enumerator that iterates through the circular buffer.
member.returns: An enumerator that can be used to iterate through the buffer from front to back.
member.remarks: The enumeration preserves the logical order of elements regardless of their physical arrangement in the internal buffer.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.CircularBuffer`1.System#Collections#IEnumerable#GetEnumerator
member.summary: Returns a non-generic enumerator that iterates through the circular buffer.

member.summary: Gets the second contiguous segment of the circular buffer.

member.returns: The file extension including the leading dot (e.g., ".txt", ".mp4").

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.PathHelper.GetAssemblyPath
member.summary: Determines and returns the directory path of the currently executing assembly.
member.returns: The directory path where the executing assembly is located, or null if unable to determine.
member.remarks:
This method attempts to retrieve the assembly path using multiple fallback strategies:
First attempts to get the location of the executing assembly
Falls back to AppContext.BaseDirectory if the first attempt returns null or empty
Finally attempts to get the entry assembly location if previous attempts fail
This approach ensures compatibility across different hosting scenarios including single-file deployments, self-contained applications, and traditional deployments.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.TextUtils.ToStringWithMask(System.DateTime,System.String)
member.summary: Formats a DateTime object using a custom mask pattern with percent-prefixed format specifiers.
member.param: The mask string containing format specifiers prefixed with '%'. For example: "%yyyy-%MM-%dd %HH:%mm:%ss" would format as "2023-12-25 14:30:45".
member.returns: A string with all percent-prefixed format specifiers replaced with their corresponding DateTime values. Returns an empty string if the mask is null or empty.

remarks.para: This extension method supports all standard .NET DateTime format specifiers when prefixed with '%':

item.description: Day: %d, %dd, %ddd, %dddd
Month: %M, %MM, %MMM, %MMMM
Year: %y, %yy, %yyy, %yyyy, %yyyyy
Hour: %h, %hh (12-hour), %H, %HH (24-hour)
Minute: %m, %mm
Second: %s, %ss
Fraction: %f through %ffffff, %F through %FFFFFFF
AM/PM: %t, %tt
Timezone: %z, %zz, %zzz, %K
Era: %g, %gg

remarks.para: The method processes format specifiers from longest to shortest to avoid partial replacements.

member.summary: Provides utility methods for user interface operations, particularly for detecting design-time environments.
member.remarks: This internal utility class helps components determine whether they are being used in a design-time environment (such as Visual Studio designer) versus runtime. This is crucial for components that need to behave differently during design time, such as avoiding resource-intensive operations or displaying placeholder content.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.Helpers.UIUtils.IsInDesignMode
member.summary: Determines whether the current code is executing within a design-time environment.
member.returns: true if the code is executing in a design-time environment (such as Visual Studio designer for WPF or Windows Forms); otherwise, false if executing at runtime.
member.remarks:
This method checks for both WPF and Windows Forms design-time environments:
For WPF: Uses to detect design-time mode.
For Windows Forms: Checks if the current process is "devenv" (Visual Studio).
This detection is useful for controls and components that need to avoid certain operations (like media playback, network access, or hardware initialization) during design time.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor
member.summary: Manages the disposal of resources used by the . This partial class implements the and patterns to ensure proper cleanup of both managed and unmanaged resources.
This partial class of handles licensing-related functionalities. It provides a method to set the license key for the Live Video Compositor SDK.
member.remarks: Proper licensing is required to unlock the full features of the Live Video Compositor SDK. The license key, along with user details, is used to validate the software's usage.
member.summary: Advanced Live Video Compositor V2 providing next-generation real-time video composition and mixing capabilities. This version offers enhanced performance, improved GPU acceleration, advanced bridge architecture, and comprehensive multi-channel video/audio processing for professional live production workflows. Built on optimized GStreamer pipeline architecture with direct hardware acceleration support and advanced synchronization capabilities. Implements the . Implements the .
member.remarks: LiveVideoCompositor V2 enhancements include: - Improved GPU acceleration with optimized rendering pipelines - Advanced bridge architecture for better input/output isolation - Enhanced multi-channel processing with independent video channels - Better synchronization and timing control for professional workflows - Optimized memory management and resource utilization - Support for higher resolution and frame rate compositions - Advanced overlay and effects management with hardware acceleration - Professional-grade audio mixing with multi-channel support Designed for demanding live production environments requiring maximum performance and reliability.
member.summary: Partial class implementation of Live Video Compositor containing overlay management functionality. This part of the class handles the creation and management of video overlays that can be added to the composited video output.
member.remarks: This partial class extends the LiveVideoCompositor with overlay capabilities, allowing text, images, and other visual elements to be overlaid on the video stream. The overlay functionality is only available on non-Android platforms.
member.summary: Provides video effects management functionality for the . This partial class allows adding, removing, and managing video effects on the compositor's output.
member.remarks: This partial class is part of the LiveVideoCompositor and specifically handles video effect operations. Effects are applied to the entire compositor output before it is sent to the various outputs. The effects system supports dynamic addition and removal of effects during playback.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.Build
member.summary: Builds the internal pipeline structure of the compositor.
member.returns: true if the build was successful; false if an error occurred.
member.remarks: This private method constructs the entire compositor pipeline including: - Video and audio mixers with appropriate settings - Bridge sources and sinks for all inputs and outputs - Fake sources for mixer stability - Tee elements for output distribution - Effects and overlay managers This method is called automatically by StartAsync().

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.DurationAsync
member.summary: Gets the current playback position of the compositor.
member.returns: A that completes with the current position.
member.remarks: For live compositing, this typically represents the elapsed time since the compositor started. The position is determined by the main pipeline's clock.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.StartAsync
member.summary: Starts the compositor and all configured inputs and outputs.
member.returns: A that completes with true if startup was successful; otherwise, false.
member.remarks:
This method performs the following operations: 1. Applies license keys to all pipelines 2. Builds the internal pipeline structure 3. Preloads all inputs and outputs for synchronized startup 4. Configures clock synchronization across all pipelines 5. Starts all components in the correct order
Inputs and outputs with AutoStart=true will begin processing immediately. Others must be started manually after the compositor is running.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.StopAsync
member.summary: Stops the compositor and all active inputs and outputs.
member.returns: A representing the asynchronous stop operation.
member.remarks:
This method stops all components in the reverse order of startup: 1. Stops all inputs 2. Stops the main pipeline 3. Stops all outputs
File outputs are properly finalized to ensure valid output files. After stopping, the compositor must be disposed and cannot be restarted.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.Input_AddAsync(VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCVideoInput)
member.summary: Adds a video-only input to the compositor.
member.returns: A that completes with true if the input was added successfully; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method can be called before or after the compositor is started. If called after startup, the input is dynamically added to the running pipeline. The input's AutoStart property determines whether it begins processing immediately. Each input is assigned a unique ID for bridge connections.
member.exception: May occur if the maximum number of inputs is exceeded.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.Input_RemoveAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Removes an input from the compositor by its unique ID.
member.param: The unique identifier of the input to remove.
member.returns: A that completes with true if the input was removed successfully; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method can be called during playback to dynamically remove inputs. It properly: - Stops the input pipeline - Blocks and removes mixer pads - Cleans up bridge connections - Releases IDs back to the pool for reuse - Disposes of all resources The removal is performed safely without interrupting other inputs or the main pipeline.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.Output_AddAsync(VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCVideoOutput,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Adds a video-only output to the compositor.
member.param: If true, starts the output immediately; otherwise, it must be started manually. Default is false.
member.returns: A that completes with true if the output was added successfully; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method can be called before or after the compositor is started. If called after startup, the output is dynamically added to the running pipeline using a tee element. The start parameter overrides the output's AutoStart property for immediate activation.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LiveVideoCompositor.Output_RemoveAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Removes an output from the compositor by its unique ID.
member.param: The unique identifier of the output to remove.
member.returns: A that completes with true if the output was removed successfully; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method stops the output pipeline gracefully and removes it from the compositor. For file outputs, this ensures proper file finalization. The output is disposed after removal.

member.returns: A that completes with true if the input was added successfully; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method requires audio to be enabled in the compositor settings. Like video inputs, audio inputs can be added dynamically during playback. Each input is assigned a unique ID for bridge connections and mixed into the main audio output.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCResizePolicy
member.summary: Defines the resize policy options for video inputs in the Live Video Compositor.
member.remarks: This enumeration controls how video inputs are scaled and positioned within their designated rectangle in the compositor. Each policy offers different trade-offs between preserving aspect ratio and filling the available space.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCResizePolicy.Letterbox
member.summary: Scales the video to fit within the target rectangle while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Black bars (letterboxing or pillarboxing) are added as needed to fill the remaining space.
member.remarks: This mode ensures the entire source video is visible without any cropping. If the aspect ratios of source and target don't match, black bars will appear either on the sides (pillarboxing) or top/bottom (letterboxing) of the video.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCResizePolicy.Stretch
member.summary: Stretches the video to completely fill the target rectangle, ignoring the original aspect ratio.
member.remarks: This mode may cause visual distortion if the source and target aspect ratios differ significantly. Use this mode when you need to fill the exact rectangle dimensions and aspect ratio preservation is not important.

member.name: F:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCResizePolicy.LetterboxToFill
member.summary: Scales the video to fill the entire target rectangle while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Parts of the video may be cropped to achieve this.
member.remarks: This mode ensures no black bars appear, but may crop portions of the source video to maintain the aspect ratio. The video is centered in the target rectangle, with equal amounts cropped from opposite sides when necessary. Also known as "zoom to fill" or "crop to fit".

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositorV2.LVCVideoAudioInput

member.remarks: This class handles input streams that contain both video and audio components. It provides separate processing pipelines for video and audio, allowing independent effects and transformations on each stream while maintaining synchronization. Like video-only inputs, it supports positioning, resize policies, and preview rendering.

member.name: T:VisioForge.Core.LiveVideoCompositor.LiveVideoCompositor
member.summary: Resource disposal and cleanup functionality for the Live Video Compositor. This partial class implements proper disposal patterns for releasing unmanaged resources, cleaning up MediaBlocks pipelines, and ensuring proper shutdown of composition operations. Provides both synchronous and asynchronous disposal methods for different cleanup scenarios. Implements the .
member.remarks: Disposal operations include: - Proper shutdown of MediaBlocks pipelines - Cleanup of video and audio mixers - Disposal of overlay managers and effects processors - Release of all input and output resources - Cleanup of tee blocks and bridge connections Both synchronous and asynchronous disposal patterns are supported for different use cases.
member.summary: License management functionality for the Live Video Compositor. This partial class handles software license validation and activation for the Live Video Compositor component. License validation ensures compliance with VisioForge licensing terms and enables full functionality. Implements the .
member.remarks: License management includes: - License key validation and storage - User credential association (username, email) - Runtime license verification - Compliance with VisioForge licensing requirements Valid license is required for full Live Video Compositor functionality in production environments.
member.summary: Provides real-time live video composition and mixing capabilities for multiple video and audio inputs. This class creates a complex MediaBlocks pipeline that can mix multiple video sources in real-time, apply video effects, manage overlay graphics, and route the composed output to multiple destinations. Supports CPU-based mixing, GPU-accelerated OpenGL mixing, Direct3D 11 composition (Windows), and input switching modes. Essential for live streaming, video production, broadcast applications, and multi-camera setups. Implements the . Implements the .
member.remarks: The Live Video Compositor manages multiple pipelines: - Main pipeline: Handles video/audio mixing and effects processing - Input pipelines: Each input source runs in its own pipeline for isolation - Output pipelines: Multiple outputs can be configured for different destinations The compositor uses bridge blocks to connect these separate pipelines efficiently.
member.summary: Overlay management functionality for the Live Video Compositor. This partial class provides methods for adding, removing, updating, and managing video overlays on individual video channels within the composition pipeline. Overlays include text, images, graphics, and other visual elements that are composited on top of the video content in real-time.
member.remarks: Video overlay capabilities include: - Real-time overlay rendering during live composition - Per-channel overlay management for independent video processing - Dynamic addition, removal, and updates of overlays without stopping composition - Support for multiple overlay types (text, images, graphics, animations) - Z-order management for layered overlay composition - Hardware-accelerated overlay rendering when available Overlays are rendered in the order they are added to each channel, with later overlays appearing on top.
member.summary: Video effects management functionality for the Live Video Compositor. This partial class provides methods for adding, updating, removing, and managing video effects on individual video channels within the composition pipeline. Effects are applied per-channel and can be dynamically added or removed during live composition operations. Implements the . Implements the . Implements the .
member.remarks: Video effects capabilities include: - Real-time effect application during live composition - Per-channel effect management for independent video processing - Dynamic addition and removal of effects without stopping composition - Effect parameter updates during live operation - Automatic pipeline state management during effect changes Effects are processed in the order they are added to each channel.
