member.summary: VideoCaptureX audio effects processing implementation. This partial class provides comprehensive audio effects management for captured audio including real-time equalizers, filters, dynamic range control, noise reduction, and audio enhancement during video capture operations. Supports both live preview and recording with audio effects applied.
Class VideoCaptureCoreX. Implements the Implements the

VideoCaptureX core initialization and pipeline management implementation. This partial class handles the fundamental setup and configuration of the MediaBlocks capture pipeline, including source initialization, encoder setup, preview configuration, recording management, and core event handling for comprehensive video capture functionality.

License management functionality for the VideoCaptureX SDK component. This partial class handles software license validation and activation for video capture operations. License validation ensures compliance with VisioForge licensing terms and enables full video capture functionality.
member.remarks: License management for VideoCaptureX includes: - License key validation and storage for video capture operations - User credential association (username, email) for license tracking - Runtime license verification for capture functionality - Compliance with VisioForge licensing requirements for video capture - Integration with registry-based license storage on Windows platforms Valid license is required for full VideoCaptureX functionality in production environments.
member.summary: Comprehensive logging and telemetry functionality for the VideoCaptureX SDK component. This partial class provides advanced logging capabilities using Serilog, error handling, telemetry integration with Sentry, and real-time error event forwarding for video capture operations. Supports both file-based logging and real-time error monitoring with configurable verbosity levels and telemetry data collection for debugging and support. Implements the Implements the
member.remarks: Logging capabilities include: - Structured logging with Serilog for comprehensive event tracking - Real-time error event forwarding to application handlers - File-based logging with rotation and size limits for debug mode - Sentry integration for telemetry and crash reporting - Context-aware logging with GStreamer integration - Observable logging patterns for real-time monitoring - Environment and system information collection for diagnostics - Configurable logging levels (Debug, Error, Warning) based on operation mode Essential for debugging video capture issues and providing support diagnostics.
member.summary: Cross-platform Video Capture SDK core class that provides comprehensive video capture and recording capabilities. This class supports multiple input sources (cameras, screen capture, files, streams), real-time effects processing, multi-format output recording, live streaming, and preview rendering. Built on the MediaBlocks pipeline system for maximum flexibility and performance across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.

VideoCaptureX output formats and destinations management implementation. This partial class handles configuration and management of various output formats and destinations including file recording (MP4, AVI, MKV), live streaming (RTMP, WebRTC, YouTube, Facebook), network output (NDI, SRT), and multi-format simultaneous recording with different quality settings.
Video Capture SDK (Cross-platform). Implements the .
Class VideoCaptureCoreX. Implements the Implements the

VideoCaptureX input sources management implementation. This partial class handles configuration and management of various video and audio input sources including cameras, screen capture, IP cameras, NDI sources, professional hardware (Decklink, GenICam), and network streams. Provides unified source selection and configuration across all supported input types.

VideoCaptureX video composition and multi-source mixing implementation. This partial class provides advanced video composition capabilities including multi-camera mixing, overlay management, picture-in-picture effects, screen capture compositing, and real-time video blending during capture operations. Supports dynamic source switching and live composition adjustments.

VideoCaptureX video effects processing implementation. This partial class provides comprehensive video effects management for captured video including real-time filters, color correction, geometric transformations, artistic effects, and video enhancement during capture operations. Supports dynamic effect adjustment for both live preview and recording output.

VideoCaptureX video processing and computer vision implementation. This partial class provides advanced video processing capabilities including motion detection, frame analysis, computer vision algorithms, barcode/QR detection, and real-time video analysis during capture operations. Integrates with OpenCV and other computer vision libraries for intelligent capture.

Provides GStreamer bus message handling for VideoEditX, managing pipeline state changes, errors, and events. This partial class handles all asynchronous communication from the GStreamer pipeline including state transitions, error propagation, end-of-stream notifications, and video overlay setup. Essential for monitoring and controlling timeline-based video editing operations through the GStreamer Editing Services (GES) framework. Implements the . Implements the .

Provides proper resource disposal for VideoEditX, ensuring clean shutdown of GStreamer pipelines, timeline objects, and associated media assets. This partial class implements the IDisposable pattern to properly release GES resources including clips, tracks, layers, and encoding profiles. Essential for preventing memory leaks in video editing applications.

Provides license management and activation functionality for VideoEditX SDK. This partial class handles license key validation, activation with user credentials, and license requirement checking for various video editing features. Manages the transition from trial to licensed operation and ensures proper licensing compliance for professional video editing capabilities. Implements the . Implements the .

Provides comprehensive logging and telemetry functionality for VideoEditX SDK using Serilog and Sentry. This partial class manages structured logging to files and debug output, error event propagation, and optional telemetry collection during development. Configures logging levels, file rotation, and integrates with Sentry for crash reporting and debugging support in video editing operations. Implements the Implements the

Cross-platform Video Editing SDK core class that provides non-linear video editing capabilities. This class supports timeline-based editing with multiple tracks, transitions, effects, text overlays, and audio mixing. Built on GStreamer Editing Services (GES) for professional-grade video editing features including precision editing, keyframe animation, and multi-format export across all platforms. Implements the and interfaces.

member.name: M:VisioForge.Core.VisioForgeX.DestroySDK
member.summary: Destroys the VisioForge SDK, releasing all allocated resources. This method should be called when the application no longer needs the SDK to prevent resource leaks.
member.returns: true if the SDK was successfully destroyed; otherwise, false.
